children: TriLinc Global Impact Fund reported approximately $283 million in portfolio assets as of September 30, 2026.
The portfolio’s weighted average loan size was approximately $10 million, with a weighted average duration of 0.4 years.
TriLinc had funded approximately $1.210 billion in aggregate investments to 103 borrower companies globally, supporting 43,572 permanent employees.
The fund had received approximately $925.2 million in transaction repayments, equal to 76% of total invested.
